description.en: A relaxing 12-minute seaside stroll on a wooden boardwalk with rolling waves, dunes, and lighthouse views.
description.fr: Une agréable promenade de 12 minutes sur ponton en bois avec vagues douces et phare marin.
description.ar: نزهة شاطئية مريحة لمدة 12 دقيقة على ممشى خشبي وسط هدير الأمواج والنسيم البحري ومنارة الشاطئ.

milestones.message: 300 Steps! The sea breeze feels wonderful.
Halfway mark! 600 Steps along the coast.

pointsOfInterest.title: Golden Coastal Boardwalk
pointsOfInterest.description: Wide timber promenade overlooking white sand and rolling gentle waves.

pointsOfInterest.title: Historic Wooden Fisher's Pier
pointsOfInterest.description: Classic wooden pillars stretching 400 meters into the sparkling ocean.

pointsOfInterest.title: Tropical Palm Oasis
pointsOfInterest.description: Tall swaying coconut palms catching the warm orange rays of the sunset.

pointsOfInterest.title: Clifftop Lookout Point
pointsOfInterest.description: Panoramic vista where dolphins can frequently be spotted on calm evenings.

pointsOfInterest.title: Historic Coastal Lighthouse
pointsOfInterest.description: Built in 1888, guiding coastal mariners with its iconic rhythmic beacon.
